### Bible Pathways 02/25/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-25-or-2002-1127470.html
Passage: Numbers 29:12
Points:
- The Feast of Tabernacles was an annual week of sacred celebration and rest following the harvest.
- Residing in temporary shelters reminded the Israelites of God's faithful care throughout the wilderness wandering.
- The water ceremony practiced during the feast foreshadowed Jesus offering living water to all who thirst.
- Sacrifices such as the peace offerings pointed ahead to the lasting fellowship believers enjoy with God through Jesus.
